newsitem.title: USA: IES Utils sees Iowa nuke on line Thursday.
newsitem.headline: IES Utils sees Iowa nuke on line Thursday.

text.p: IES Utilities Inc said the 538 megawatt Duane Arnold nuclear power plant was expected to reconnect to the electricity grid Thursday following a maintenance outage which began on Friday.
"It is in the process of returning to service, we are hopeful it will synchonize to the electricity grid before the end of the day," a company spokesman said Thursday.
The plant, located in Palo, Iowa, was earlier Thursday reported by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission to be operating at near 12 percent of capacity following the beginning of startup on Wednesday.
IES Utilities is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
